title: Landing page
brief:
A landing page for Orbit, as a web page.

- A hero band across the whole window, background #111827, white text:
  - Heading: "Ship every surface from one template"
  - Text: "Orbit renders your emails, pages and PDFs from the same components."
  - Button "Start free" linking to https://orbit.dev/signup, background #6d5efc, white text.
- A band across the whole window, background #f1f2f6, with a grid of three features, each a title over a line of text:
  - "Emails": "Table layouts every inbox reads."
  - "Pages": "Responsive HTML for the web."
  - "PDFs": "Print-ready documents from the same code."
- The three features are side by side on wide windows and stacked one under another on windows up to 640px wide (so a 600px window stacks them too).
- A footer band, white: "Orbit Labs, 500 Market St, San Francisco" and a link "Docs" to https://orbit.dev/docs, colored #6d5efc and turning #4c3df0 on hover.
- Content 1080px wide.
